# E0146: a reference cannot be resolved statically

A schema selects a field of the lineage by a label only an instance decides.
CUE leaves the selection pending, and thema cannot tell from the schema what
the reference denotes (reference rule ref-unresolved). Written with constant
labels it would be a reference thema can judge (a label the evaluator can
fold, such as lin["na"+"me"], already is: it resolves to lin.name); either
way, the schema writes the literal it wants.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
lin: {
	name: "ship"
	schemas: {
		"0": "0": {
			schema: {a: string, n: lin[a]}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0146]: n in schema 0.0 refers to the lineage[...], which thema cannot resolve statically
 --> lineage.cue:5:27
  |
5 |             schema: {a: string, n: lin[a]}
  |                                    ^^^
  |
  = note: reference rule ref-unresolved
  = help: write the reference with constant labels, or declare what it needs inside the schema
```
